title: 10 out of 10 programming resources
transcript: 10/10 free programming resources, but it gets increasingly more niche. Harvard CS50, taught by one of the top universities in the world and doesn't teach you just how to program, but the fundamentals behind computer science. It's extremely good for learning the fundamentals. exercism.org, it's a website that has 83 different programming road maps [music] that takes you from the fundamentals of that programming language all the way to advanced. Because it's a road map, you won't get thrown into the hardest concepts right off the bat. >> [music] >> quickref.me, it's a website that has tons of cheat sheets and cheat sheets for every programming language under the sun. That way when you're creating your first [music] couple of projects, you have something to still wrap your head around. Get a policy of free coding resources
